original_benchmark.name: robust-kbench
original_benchmark.paper_title: Robust-KBench: A Robustness-focused CUDA Kernel Generation Benchmark
original_benchmark.notes: Sakana AI released benchmark focusing on robustness and correctness of generated CUDA kernels under varied input tensor shapes and initialization settings.

harbor_adapter.name: robust-kbench
harbor_adapter.notes: Adapted with multi_input_settings=True, multi_init_settings=True, and NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE=0. Excludes mnist_conv_relu_pool__forward by default because its upstream golden kernel exceeds consumer GPU 100KB shared-memory limits.
